title: Remove Save/Load options and enforce Free Tier 3-model ROM limit

requirements.text: Remove the 'Save' and 'Load' model buttons from the DashboardHeader component. These buttons currently appear in the sticky top navigation header. Remove all UI elements, click handlers, and related modal triggers for both SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from DashboardHeader.
acceptanceCriteria: The DashboardHeader no longer renders Save or Load model buttons
SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal are no longer triggered from DashboardHeader
No console errors related to removed modal handlers

requirements.text: Remove SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from any other locations where they are rendered or triggered (e.g., ProjectContext, DashboardPage, or any other component that exposes Save/Load project functionality).
acceptanceCriteria: SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal are not rendered anywhere in the application
No orphaned state or handlers related to save/load project remain active in the UI

requirements.text: Add a backend counter per user that tracks how many times the ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) inputs have been used/submitted. The counter must persist in the user's profile. Free Tier users are allowed a maximum of 3 uses. The backend must expose a method to get the current ROM usage count and a method to increment it, with access control that rejects increments beyond 3 for Free Tier users.

quotes: Make the Free Tier to be 3 models in which when the person uses 3 times the inputs of ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) the app blocks the usage of these inputs and asks the person to buy the Premium Tier.

acceptanceCriteria: User profile data structure includes a romUsageCount field (default 0)
A backend method increments romUsageCount for the authenticated caller
Free Tier users cannot increment beyond 3; the method returns an error or #err variant when the limit is reached
Premium Tier users are not subject to the ROM usage limit
romUsageCount is returned as part of the user profile query response

requirements.text: In the ReservesProductionSection component, track ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) usage against the backend counter. When a Free Tier user has used ROM inputs 3 times (romUsageCount >= 3), disable all Annual ROM Tonnage Schedule inputs and display a prominent inline message prompting the user to upgrade to Premium Tier. The message must include a call-to-action that opens the SubscriptionModal. Before reaching the limit, each time the user applies/confirms ROM inputs, increment the backend romUsageCount counter.

quotes: when the person uses 3 times the inputs of ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) the app blocks the usage of these inputs and asks the person to buy the Premium Tier.

acceptanceCriteria: Annual ROM Tonnage Schedule inputs are fully interactive for Free Tier users until romUsageCount reaches 3
On the 3rd use, the counter is incremented to 3 and inputs remain usable for that session only
When romUsageCount >= 3 and user is Free Tier, all ROM tonnage inputs are disabled/read-only
A visible upgrade prompt message is shown within the ROM section explaining the limit has been reached
The upgrade prompt includes a button that opens the SubscriptionModal
Premium Tier users see no restrictions on ROM inputs
The disabled state and prompt persist across page reloads (driven by backend counter)

requirements.text: Update the ProjectContext to expose romUsageCount from the user profile and provide a helper function to increment it via the backend. This data should be accessible to ReservesProductionSection and any component that needs to check or update ROM usage.

quotes: when the person uses 3 times the inputs of ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) the app blocks the usage of these inputs

acceptanceCriteria: ProjectContext exposes romUsageCount (number) derived from the user profile
ProjectContext exposes an incrementRomUsage() async helper that calls the backend increment method
After incrementing, the user profile query is invalidated so romUsageCount reflects the updated value

constraints: Do not remove save/load backend methods — only remove the frontend UI entry points for Save and Load model actions
Free Tier ROM limit is exactly 3 uses; Premium Tier has no ROM input restrictions
All user-facing text must be in English
nonGoals: Removing the Export tab or its CSV export functionality
Changing any other Free Tier restrictions beyond the ROM usage limit
Modifying the SubscriptionModal's internal checkout flow
Removing backend save/load project data methods
